rationale: The bid-ask spread of ~472 bps is prohibitively wide, meaning any position starts with an immediate ~2.4% adverse slippage just to enter and exit. The stock has gapped down sharply (~7%) from prior close with no news context, making directional conviction very low — the last few candles show a volatile, choppy bounce off the $29.57 low with no clear momentum or stabilization pattern. The combination of extreme spread cost, high uncertainty about the gap catalyst, and already-committed capital in working orders makes this an unfavorable risk/reward setup in either direction.
